vibe_rationale: Deep, community-trusted and heavily curated multi-format culture, but 40,000 scale and a strict no-sponsor policy fail the brand-friendly trait.
fit_notes: Strong wellness and consciousness adjacency, but Boom takes no sponsors or logos, so only vendor stall space is sold and a branded activation is effectively off the table. As an Australian brand, High Ground would need a local partner to take a stall.
